updateConfirm.bodyAgent: The panel downloads the package from the core, verifies its SHA-256, installs it and restarts the agent. Containers are not touched; the server shows offline for a moment.
updateConfirm.bodyAll: The panel downloads each package from the core, verifies its SHA-256, installs it and restarts the agent. Containers are not touched; each server shows offline for a moment.
